verdict.rationale: Caveman Cloud stores agent call history and spend data, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no retention periods, deletion, or data-purge capability. The closest features are rules that mask or block content before it reaches a model, and an audit trail of changes. These are adjacent privacy controls, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
